title: fix(app-shell): name the action editor's icon picker and pin the Studio controls' accessible names (objectui#12510)
body:
Fixes #12510
Clause-②: no

## What the tree says

I measured the card's controls on current main (572bbce, HotCRM 63db83e on objectstack dev --fresh, the console from this worktree on vite) with the browser's own computed tree: CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree, the source chrome-devtools-mcp reads, cross-checked with Playwright ariaSnapshot. Every control the card lists has a name in that tree, made from its visible text. The markup behind the card's readings is the same at d4bc81eab, where the card was measured, so the 'no name' readings came from the tool, not the tree. One control really had no name: the action editor's icon picker, folded into the card by comment 6199308787. One more was named by its value alone, without the label shown beside it: the Explain access sheet's User picker.

## What changed

- **ActionDefaultInspector icon picker.** The picker is a combobox, a role that takes no name from its content, and the Icon label beside it was bound to nothing. It now gets one React.useId(): the Label's htmlFor and the IconPickerWidget's id, the shape objectui#12531 gave the object and app-nav icon fields.
- **Explain access sheet, User picker.** The picker button was named by the principal it shows alone ('Me (calling principal)'), and the visible User label above it was bound to nothing. The label and the value span each get a React.useId(), and the button is aria-labelledby both, so its name reads 'User Me (calling principal)', or User and the picked person's name. The Object, Operation and Record fields beside it already used their labels.
- Neither change alters anything on screen; existing testids and i18n keys stay. Changeset: one app-shell patch covering both pickers.
- **Pins by role and name (acceptance 1)**, one test beside each surface, so a restyle that hides a label from the tree turns red:
  - ListView.toolbarNames-12510: Hide fields, Filter, Group, Sort (test only; ListView.tsx untouched).
  - Add field: already pinned by role and name in DataPillar.layoutBadge.test.tsx.
  - flow-canvas-parts.nodeName-12510: the Start and End node buttons, named by label then kind.
  - DraftChangesPanel.accessibleNames-12510: the row expander, named by the item label first, and Close.
  - Record sharing (OWD): already pinned by role and name in StudioDesignSurface.accessGuard.test.tsx.
  - AccessExplainPanel.accessibleNames-12510: the user picker named 'User Me (calling principal)', and Close.
  - BuilderLanding.accessibleNames-12510: the recent link (getByRole link, name HotCRM), the writable and installed cards, Organization flows, New package, and no button or link left without a name.
  - PackageFormDialog.closeName-12510: Close, Cancel, Create package.

## Relation to objectui#12575

objectui#12575 (for objectui#12500) adds aria-labels to Filter, Export and Add record in ListView.tsx for narrow screens. This PR makes no change to ListView.tsx and adds only a pin file of its own. That pin checks Hide fields, Filter, Group and Sort at desktop width with no filter applied, where the Filter name is 'Filter' with or without that PR. Below sm, Hide fields, Group and Sort are hidden as whole buttons, so they never show up as unnamed buttons.

## Accessibility tree, before (572bbce) and after

The card's controls, trimmed. Each line is role and computed name. The after column was read live at e69804c; the Explain user picker's after name comes from the 12510 pin, which reads the name the test DOM computes, at 6451ee1.

- Data, Records tab (HotCRM, Account). Before and after: button Hide fields · button Filter · button Group · button Sort · button Refresh · button Search · button Add record · 32 x button Edit field properties. Unnamed button, link or combobox: 0 before, 0 after.
- Flow canvas (Automations, the first HotCRM flow). Before and after: button Start START crm_campaign · button End END. Unnamed: 0 / 0.
- Pending-changes sheet (writable package, one object draft, row expanded). Before and after: button Ticket a11y_ticket New (expanded) · button Publish all · button Close. Unnamed: 0 / 0.
- Access rail and the Explain access sheet. Before: button Record sharing (OWD) · button Me (calling principal) · combobox Object · combobox Operation · button Explain · button Close. After: the same, with the user picker named User Me (calling principal). Unnamed: 0 / 0 (167 controls on the rail page, 7 in the sheet).
- Studio home (after visiting two packages). Before and after: link HotCRM app.objectstack.hotcrm · link A11y Test com.example.a11y · button A11y Test com.example.a11y · button HotCRM app.objectstack.hotcrm Read-only · button Organization flows ... · button New package (writable base) · button DA (avatar). Unnamed: 0 / 0.
- New package dialog. Before and after: button Close · button Cancel · button Create package · combobox Type. Unnamed: 0 / 0.
- Action editor (HotCRM object actions, an action open). Before: combobox with an empty name, text phone. After: combobox Icon. Unnamed: 1 before, 0 after.

## Deviations

- The card's readings for the other listed controls did not reproduce in the browser's tree, so no markup changed for them. Their names are pinned instead.
- The Add field header button was not measured live (the test object's Records tab showed its empty state). By code it carries aria-label Add field (components data-table.tsx), and an existing test queries it by role and name.
- No screenshots: the visual output is unchanged by rule.
- The claim's file surface was extended to metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx by the dispatch seat for the User picker.

## Acceptance notes

- The Records grid's read-only boolean cells (is_active) render 9 checkboxes with no name, from the fields package's boolean cell renderer. Checkbox is outside this card's button, link and combobox scope, and the report lists it as a finding.
- The top-bar avatar is named by the user's initials.

## Test evidence (6451ee1)

- pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test: exit 0, 1416 test files passed, 1 skipped; 13471 tests passed, 9 skipped. Run on 52c7ff6, before the User picker change; CI reruns it on this head.
- Targeted vitest at ac92f6f (which differs from 6451ee1 only in the changeset prose) over the four AccessExplainPanel files and the card's pins: 10 files, 39 tests passed.
- Ablations: removing the icon picker's id turns ActionDefaultInspector.iconPickerName-12510 red ('Unable to find an accessible element with the role combobox and name Icon'); removing the User picker's aria-labelledby turns AccessExplainPanel.accessibleNames-12510 red ('Unable to find an accessible element with the role button and name User Me (calling principal)'). After each restore, git diff HEAD is empty.
- type-check (app-shell, plugin-list, tests included): exit 0. build: exit 0 (at e69804c). eslint on touched files: exit 0. check:i18n-keys, check:i18n-drift (at e69804c), check-changeset-presence (at 6451ee1): exit 0.
